invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.22.0 preserves the completed billing product, business-owner payment-provider connections, customer-facing hosted Pay Now, Safaricom M-PESA Express STK Push, and truthful payment-webhook observability. Provider setup now distinguishes callbackConfigured from callbackVerified: owner confirmation or provider API registration can make a callback configured, but SaMi only marks it verified after a provider event has been cryptographically or provider-authoritatively validated. Existing last_received_at evidence remains backward-compatible. Customer checkout remains available once setup is configured because provider-return verification and the authoritative settlement core still protect posting. M-PESA retains C2B Paybill/Till reconciliation and encrypted STK credentials. The release gate includes Invoicing/payment regressions, provider connector contracts, quality locks, module migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
